summary:
Implementation plan for character entries and 4-frame proto_knight sprite:
- Establishes src/cartridges/knight/database/characters/ directory for player and NPC archetypes
- Creates proto_knight.ts defining base health, stamina, energy, physics, starting equipment, and sprite metadata
- Creates enemy_knight.ts with matching combat moveset, AI patrolling, block/parry, and telegraphed attacks
- Integrates the new 4-frame proto_knight sprite sheet (72x18) with updated walk cycle animation
- Hooks character entries into knightCartridge initialization, enemies update loop, and satchel display
